extractor_rules.rule: Single-underscore top-level functions are not visible; only ordinary public functions and selected dunder protocol names are admitted.

A top-level class is admitted only if its name does not start underscore. Children are visited only after class admission, so public-named pauses_animation inside private _AnimationResourcePolicy is excluded.
Nested inventory requires a lexically enclosing function/async function. A method of a module-level class alone does not qualify.
